name: ecc
description: Harness-native ECC plugin for engineering teams - 68 agents, 295 skills, 94 commands, reusable hooks, rules, MCP conventions, and operator workflows for Claude Code plus adjacent agent harnesses

hooks_enabled.title: Enable ECC hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Run ECC's local lifecycle, quality, and safety automation. Disable this to keep skills and commands without local hook automation.

hook_profile.title: ECC hook profile
hook_profile.description: Choose minimal, standard, or strict. Invalid values safely fall back to standard.

main_git_ask.title: Ask before git commit on main
main_git_ask.description: Prompt to approve git commit on main, and new branches or worktrees in the primary checkout. One machine-wide switch via /plugin configure ecc@ecc. A single repo can still set ECC_MAIN_GIT_ASK=off in that repo .claude/settings.json env.
